facts.fact: 接下来的两天里哈蒂没见到任何人、没和任何人说话、与外界没有任何联系。
facts.anchor: For the next two days she doesn’t see another person, doesn’t speak to anyone, has no contact with the outside world.

facts.fact: 哈蒂在厨房桌上架设工作台，因为那里光线最好，配了笔记本电脑、记事本、笔和喝不完的茶。
facts.anchor: She creates a workstation at the kitchen table since it has the best light in the cottage and equips it with her laptop, a notepad and pens, and a bottomless cup of tea.

facts.fact: 第二天哈蒂播放了一个标注为 Ginger Beckem 的音频，引起她兴趣的是标注 Leah Sterling 同事的备注。
facts.anchor: It’s marked Ginger Beckem, but it’s the notation not the name that sparks her interest—Leah Sterling coworker.

facts.fact: 金杰说她只见过汤米一次，是在事情发生前的一场派对上，那时他和莉娅刚复合。
facts.anchor: I really only met Tommy once. It was at a party right before all that sh—stuff went down.

facts.fact: 金杰说莉娅告诉她，汤米开始和谢瑞尔约会只是为了让她嫉妒。
facts.anchor: Leah told me he only started dating that Cheryl to make her jealous.

facts.fact: 金杰说莉娅很聪明，帮她拿到了 GED 文凭。
facts.anchor: She was hella smart. She helped me with my GED.

facts.fact: 金杰说谢瑞尔来到 Pizza Train 后，莉娅出来跟她说些关于汤米的话，并让她到外面去谈。
facts.anchor: Then Leah comes out and Cheryl starts saying some stuff about Tommy, and Leah makes her go outside to talk.

facts.fact: 金杰说谢瑞尔威胁莉娅离汤米远点，否则就杀了她。
facts.anchor: Because Cheryl said she’d better stay away from Tommy otherwise she’d kill her.

facts.fact: 金杰强调说这话还不到一周，谢瑞尔就死了。
facts.anchor: Real ironic because it wasn’t a week later and she was dead.
